full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media photographic collage shows a lone figure in a vivid red dress facing a damaged high-rise across a debris-strewn open space. The sky and much of the surrounding field are nearly white, marked by fine black scratches, dust spots, and faint vertical construction lines. A tall concrete apartment block fills the center, extending beyond the top edge. Its facade is broken into stacked rooms, dark window holes, ragged balconies, and exposed ochre-gray masonry. Parts of the left side seem torn away, producing a jagged silhouette against the pale ground. In the foreground, the red-clad figure stands near the central axis with the back to the viewer and dark hair visible above the collar. The hem falls around the knees, and bare-looking lower legs remain small against the vast structure. Tiny scattered people stand nearer the building, reduced to dark marks along the horizon line. Broken pavement, rubble, and shallow reflective puddles occupy the lower strip of the frame. The surface combines photograph-like architectural detail with scraped, distressed, and slightly fragmented textures; small black specks hover through the pale spaces. Diffuse gray daylight reaches the open ground, while the interiors of the ruin remain almost black. The red garment is the only strongly saturated area amid concrete cream, dust gray, and brown. The enormous vertical ruin, the small centered figure, and the wide scarred white field make the image solemn, sparse, and confrontational.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介摄影拼贴描绘一位穿鲜红裙装的孤身人物，隔着遍布碎屑的空地面对受损高楼。天空和周围大部分区域近乎白色，带细小黑色划痕、灰尘点和淡淡竖向结构线。高大的混凝土公寓楼填满中央，向上伸出画边。立面分裂为层叠房间、深暗窗洞、破碎阳台和裸露的赭灰色墙体。左侧一部分像被撕走，在浅色底上形成参差剪影。前景红衣人物站在中轴附近，背对观者，领口上方可见深发。衣摆落在膝部周围，下方的腿在巨大建筑前显得细小。更靠近楼房处有零星小人物，在地平线附近缩成深色记号。破损路面、瓦砾和浅浅反光水洼占据画面下方窄带。表面把摄影般的建筑细节与刮擦、磨损和略碎裂的纹理结合；浅色空处漂着细黑点。漫射灰日光照到开阔地，废墟内部却近乎黑色。红衣是混凝土奶油色、灰尘灰和褐色之间唯一强饱和区域。巨大的竖向废墟、居中小人物和宽阔带伤痕的白色场地，使图像庄重、稀疏而有直面感。
style_prompt_en: Distressed photographic collage combines recognizably dimensional fragments with scraped paper, scattered black flecks, and faint structural lines. Large cream-white and dust-gray areas leave a damaged focal mass exposed, while a very small saturated red accent interrupts the muted concrete palette. Texture alternates between precise tiny architectural details and abrupt torn-looking edges. Light is broad and overcast, so dark recesses read as voids rather than modeled soft shadows. A monumental vertical element faces a small isolated color point across a low strip of fragmented ground, establishing scale through emptiness. The solemn rhythm depends on stark size contrast, weathered surfaces, and the uneven balance of dense ruin against pale negative space.
style_prompt_zh: 磨损的摄影拼贴把仍有可辨体积的碎片与刮擦纸面、分散黑点和淡淡结构线结合。大片奶油白与尘灰让受损焦点体块裸露，一小处饱和红打断柔暗混凝土调色。纹理在精确细小的建筑细节与突然撕裂般的边缘之间交替。光宽广而阴天化，使深凹处成为空洞，而非柔和塑形的阴影。巨大的竖向元素与孤立的小色点隔着低矮碎裂地带相对，以空旷建立尺度。庄重节奏依赖强烈尺寸对比、风化表面，以及密集废墟与浅色负空间的不均衡。
theme_en: A lone red-clad figure facing a damaged high-rise across rubble
theme_zh: 一位身穿红衣的孤身人物隔着瓦砾面对受损高楼
name: 城市废墟拼贴摄影
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
